name: ckanext-fuseki
purpose: Integrates Apache Jena Fuseki as a triple store mirror of CKAN datasets. For each RDF resource in a dataset, creates a Fuseki dataset (named by CKAN dataset UUID), uploads resources as named graphs, and creates a SPARQL resource link in CKAN pointing to a CKAN-proxied SPARQL endpoint.
auto_hooks_state: DISABLED — after_create and after_update hooks are commented out in plugin.py. Fuseki sync is triggered manually via the fuseki_update CKAN action (accessible from dataset UI or API).
trigger_condition: resource format (lowercased) must be in ckanext.fuseki.formats
dataset_naming: Fuseki dataset name = CKAN package (dataset) UUID directly. No secondary mapping table.
upload_flow: Delete existing Fuseki dataset for package UUID (if present)
Poll for confirmed deletion (verify_dataset_deleted, up to 10 retries)
Re-create dataset via Fuseki Assembly API (Turtle assembler POSTed to $/datasets) — configures TDB2, sets unionDefaultGraph=true, optional OWL/RDFS reasoning
Upload each RDF resource via Graph Store Protocol PUT to {dataset_url}/data?graph={named_graph_uri} — PUT replaces content, prevents stale triples
Clean up orphaned named graphs (for removed resources)
Create or patch a CKAN resource named 'SPARQL' with URL pointing to CKAN proxy endpoint
sparql_proxy_endpoint: /dataset/{id}/fuseki/$/sparql — CKAN authenticates before forwarding to Fuseki; users never hit Fuseki directly

registered_actions.purpose: Upload/sync all RDF resources of a CKAN dataset to Fuseki
Delete the Fuseki dataset for a CKAN dataset

configuration.description: Fuseki base URL — use internal container URL in DataStack
Optional direct URL bypassing nginx reverse proxy
Fuseki admin password — change before deploying
CKAN API token for background job authentication

configuration.default: turtle text/turtle n3 nt hext trig longturtle xml json-ld ld+json jsonld
configuration.description: Resource formats that trigger Fuseki upload
Sparklis UI URL (empty = use built-in YASGUI)

capabilities: CKAN UUID → Fuseki dataset: stable, predictable naming, no mapping table needed
Named graph per resource: tracks provenance by resource download URL
Union default graph: cross-resource SPARQL queries work out of the box
Optional OWL/RDFS reasoning: inference graphs created automatically
CKAN proxy: users access SPARQL without direct Fuseki credentials
Sparklis integration: user-friendly faceted SPARQL UI as alternative to YASGUI
PUT (replace not append) prevents accumulation of stale triples
limitations: Auto-hooks are commented out — Fuseki sync requires manual trigger via CKAN UI or API; does NOT happen automatically on resource upload
Delete-and-recreate strategy means Fuseki is briefly empty during large dataset re-syncs
Resource URLs must be publicly accessible for Fuseki to fetch RDF content
Reasoning adds inference triples — can significantly increase storage for large ontologies
BACKGROUNDJOBS_API_TOKEN must be set or jobs will not execute
